title: Install a software package using Homebrew
summary: Use Homebrew to install command-line tools (formulae) or graphical applications (casks). This is the standard way to add new software on macOS and many Linux distributions.

aliases.text: how to install app with homebrew

prerequisites: Homebrew is installed on the system

steps.explain: Install the latest stable version of a specific formula (command-line tool) or cask (graphical app).

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the formula or cask to install

verify.expect: The installed package name appears in the list

rollback.explain: Homebrew does not provide a simple undo command on this page. To remove the package, you must use the uninstall command manually.

warnings: Installing software modifies your system. Ensure you trust the source of the package.
